# BOX DIAMONDS

> BOX DIAMONDS is an Indian fine jewellery brand selling certified natural diamond jewellery online at boxdiamonds.com, with delivery across India. It is operated by Goldbox Diamonds Private Limited, Mumbai, Maharashtra.

- Natural diamonds certified by IGI or GIA; the certificate is supplied with the jewellery.
- Made in BIS-hallmarked 9K and 18K gold, in yellow, rose and white gold.
- Lightweight designs crafted by our own artisans, with transparent pricing.
- Free shipping across India through insured, tracked partners (unless a delivery charge is shown at checkout). Most pieces are made to order: usually 4–5 days to make, then 3–4 days in transit.
- 7-day returns with free pickup for eligible products. Solitaire jewellery, loose diamonds and engraved pieces are not returnable.
- Exchange and buyback on eligible jewellery, subject to the conditions shown at purchase.
- Contact: info@boxdiamonds.com. Registered office: No 281/287, 39 1-3, Narsi Natha Street, Princess Dock, Mumbai – 400009, Maharashtra, India.
